Title: Advisory Warning Trigger
Objective: Verify advisory warning appears only when screen time ? 20 minutes
Preconditions: Parent logged in, child profile set
Test Steps:
1. Set screen time to 15 ? Observe warning
2. Set screen time to 20 ? Observe warning
3. Set screen time to 25 ? Observe warning
Expected Result: Warning appears only at 20 minutes and above

Title: Password Prompt After Screen Time Expiry
Objective: Verify password prompt appears after screen time ends
Preconditions: Parent logged in, child profile set
Test Steps:
1. Set screen time to 15
2. Allow time to expire
Expected Result: Password prompt appears requiring parent's birth year

Title: Invalid Password Entry
Expected Result: Access denied, app does not continue

Title: Password Re-Prompt After 5 Minutes
Objective: Verify password prompt reappears after 5 minutes of resumed usage
Test Steps:
1. Enter valid password 1980
2. Use app for 5 minutes

Title: No Password Entered
Objective: Verify app self-closes if password is not entered
Test Steps:
1. Allow screen time to expire
2. Do not enter password
